# wontbetold Productions
> Independent production company making films and theatrical productions.

## About
wontbetold Productions develops and produces original work for screen and stage: films, theatre, commercials and music videos. It was founded by Christapor Yaacoubian, who is its Creative Director.

Its main project is Meurants Lane: a stage play shortlisted for Sydney Theatre Company's Patrick White Playwrights' Award in 2022, which sold out its 2024 season at La Mama Theatre, Melbourne, and won Excellence in New Writing at the 2025 Dionysus Awards. A proof of concept film is complete and the feature is in development for 2027.

The company's line is "we wont be told, and neither should you".
